title: Portable stat editor no-REGISTER smoke independent review
scope: Independent offline replay and visual review of the four-run no-REGISTER smoke. No emulation/core was started during this review.

run_chain.chain_integrity: Each later run's physical state input resolves to the preceding run's output state hash.
run_chain.rom_core_runner_and_no_cheats: Pinned and checked for every run.

verified_checks: The cold run has no state input; it starts from the fixed candidate and seed DSV.
All four runs bind physical result, RAM dump, input script, output state, frozen DSV snapshot, and sidecar hashes.
The seed DSV is CRC/header checked, hash-identical across the isolated profile, and the recorded runtime battery path remains unchanged.
Party snapshots match the selected DSV through exact native cipher-boundary checks; the runtime SaveArray3 bytes match the seed DSV.
The canonical Bag bytes are identical across the four RAM snapshots and key item 118 remains quantity 1.
Reserve sections at 0x023D5000, 0x023D6000, and 0x023D7000 match the candidate ROM bytes in every run.
The family menu is captured with EVs/IVs/Exit; RAM UI mode/state reads 3/1 there and 0/1 after Exit.

visual_review.context_menu: kit_context_final.png visibly shows USE, MOVE, and CANCEL; REGISTER/DESELECT are absent.
visual_review.party_and_family: Party selector highlights Clefairy; family menu shows EVs, IVs, Exit.

limits: This is a bounded no-write smoke, not EV/IV operation acceptance.
Save and fresh-process cold persistence for editor actions were not tested.
REGISTER/DESELECT absence was independently checked visually, not via automated OCR.
Canonical Bag bytes are compared across these four RAM snapshots; the auditor does not claim a direct Bag-buffer-to-DSV byte mapping.
No whole-game or broader regression acceptance is implied.
